title: Predictable nonce from generateRandomNonce
description: generateRandomNonce derives nonces from the previous nonce and block properties (blockhash, timestamp, coinbase), and the initial lastNonce is predictable. Future nonces can be predicted, so a receiveMessage call can pre-mark a future nonce as used and cause a denial of service; only the trusted-relayer restriction lowers the severity.

title: Revert strings instead of custom errors
description: require statements use hard-coded revert strings; custom errors would reduce deployment and runtime gas and give structured error data.

title: Centralization risk: owner-only pause and unpause
description: pause and unpause are callable only by the owner, a single point of failure if that key is compromised; multi-signature control is recommended.

title: Centralization risk: unrestricted emergency withdrawal
description: The owner can withdraw any amount of ether from the Treasury at any time with no timelock, limit, or multi-party approval. A compromised or malicious owner can drain user funds.
